findings: GPUUniformBuf uses PyObject_GetBuffer(PyBUF_SIMPLE) and passes bytes directly to GPU_uniformbuf_create_ex; length must be a multiple of 16.
GPUTexture constructor rejects data buffers except FLOAT.
GPUTexture.read selects GPU_DATA_UINT explicitly for GPU_R32UI; GPU_RGBA32UI falls through to FLOAT.
GPUTexture.clear UINT uses PyLong conversion to a 32-bit int union; positive poison 0x5A5A5A5A avoids signed overflow, with one component for R32UI.
